revision: Bounded joint stabilization and native-independent public mode-2 writeback

physicsPolicy.mode2Writeback: Rotation only; authored local translation preserved; no native origin or velocity feedback.

jointPositionStabilization.lockedJointClusters: Position projection only, root-centred unit-radius inverse-mass metric. All source Bullet bodies/joints/masses/inertias/springs/filters retained.
jointPositionStabilization.otherBodies: Ammo-calculated shape inertia; 3x3 locked-anchor block solves and angular/limited-axis gradients.

physicsPolicy.legacyV1SyntheticPolicy: Unchanged; stabilized mode is explicitly selected by the public host.

limits.nativeWindowsMMD: Unverified; position stabilization is a project numerical policy, not original-MMD parity.
limits.physicalAndroid: Unperformed; existing required post-merge device plan remains pending.
limits.completeBrowserSuite: Only the recorded relevant selections were run; no unrelated full matrix or optional native-WebGPU run.
limits.jointAccuracy: Both models/motions and IK states have explicit per-joint linear/angular bounds in all three worlds. Gene cloak joints 51..67 retain finite linear strain; the 30 mm ceiling matches the established synthetic drift bound and never applies to locked counterweights.
limits.performance: Three-world Physics On is opt-in and not realtime in this software-rendered environment; fixed tick scheduling, cancellation and the existing 150 ms device work guard remain.

evidenceSerialization: Complete per-joint errors are worst-of-three-pane maxima. Static controller inventories are in public-physics-audit.json; duplicate chain inventories and repeated morph weight arrays are summarized here.
